about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the planner, the owner, both critics and the integrator ran as their own subagents; the owner was dispatched at least twice (one piece per outer round) and the piece critic at least twice; each critic wrote its own report; the owner and the integrator never read the held-out reference and both critics did; a back edge was taken; PIECES.md ends with every box ticked; the run halts at release-gate. One scripted gate answer, at the decomposition gate only (owner decision 2026-09-22, as for spec-then-loop's first gate in batch one): without it nothing past the planner runs and the design bet cannot be tested. The release gate gets no scripted answer. The design bet (write-up): piece 1's obvious rendering misses properties of the reference that only a side-by-side shows, so e-critic-fail fires at least once, and both pieces end ticked.

resume.prompt: Answer at the gate `{{gate}}` of run `{{run-id}}`: {{answer}}. Continue that run from where it halted.
